description: Default options of the yamlprims specification revision 1.1: YAML 1.2.2 Core resolution (section 4), integers limited to i128::MIN..=u128::MAX, explicit core tags directing resolution, non-core tags retained with a raw string inner, duplicate keys rejected (section 5.2), strict flow indentation in every parsing pass (section 9, 1.1/E-4), merge_keys = AsKey (section 5.3), and single-document entrypoints. Error kinds are the specification's snake_case ErrorKind names.
